newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BRUINS STOP LIGHTNING 3-0.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-BRUINS STOP LIGHTNING 3-0.

text.p: Bill Ranford recorded his second shutout of the season and Troy Mallette had a goal and an assist as the Boston Bruins broke a five-game home winless streak by blanking the Tampa Bay Lightning 3-0 on Thursday.
Ranford made 34 saves for his 14th career shutout, stopping 14 shots in the third period.
Rick Tabaracci made 22 saves for the Lightning, who have suffered back-to-back losses following a season-high five-game unbeaten streak.

In Ottawa, Daniel Alfredsson scored on a power play and Dave Hannan added a shorthanded tally 55 seconds later to highlight a four-goal second period as the Ottawa Senators snapped a three-game winless streak with a 5-2 triumph over the Florida Panthers.
Bruce Gardiner and Alexei Yashin had the other second-period goals for Ottawa, which won for just the third time in 12 games.
Radek Dvorak and Johan Garpenlov scored for Florida.
"More than us playing badly, we can credit Ottawa for playing a good game," said Panthers coach Doug MacLean. "We had some great chances, but couldn't convert them into goals."
In Philadelphia, Garth Snow made 24 saves for his second shutout in six days, and Eric Lindros had two goals and two assists as the Flyers beat the New York Islanders 5-0.
Snow, who entered the season without a shutout in 33 NHL games, got his first on Saturday against Hartford.
The Flyers have not allowed a goal in the last 202:30.
John LeClair and Janne Niinimaa each had a goal and an assist.
In St Louis, Ken Wregget recorded his second shutout of the season, Mario Lemieux had a natural hat trick in the second period as the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the St. Louis Blues 4-0.
The Penguins dominated throughout, outshooting St. Louis over the first two periods, 21-12, and establishing a 4-0 lead.
